title: Siege of Anapa (1828)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Anapa (1828)", at revision 1370738824, opens: "The Siege of Anapa was a key military operation during both the Russo-Circassian War and the Russo-Turkish War. Taking place between May 14 and June 24, 1828, it marked a significant Russian victory, as the strategic Ottoman fortress of Anapa fell to Russian forces after weeks of intense fighting. The capture of Anapa weakened Ottoman influence in the north-eastern Black Sea region and disrupted Circassian coordination against Russian expansion." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q119166596, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1828 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
